data.headline: Q2 revenue fell amid SRG’s asset-sale plan

citation.quote:
XBRL frame Revenues CY2026Q2 (USD). Row for this filer:
{"accn":"0001193125-26-352329","cik":1628063,"entityName":"SERITAGE GROWTH PROPERTIES","loc":"US-NY","start":"2026-04-01","end":"2026-06-30","val":1874000}

claims.text: Compared with Q2 2025 revenue of $4,653,000, Q2 2026 revenue declined $2,779,000, or 59.7% year over year.

citation.quote:
XBRL frame Revenues CY2025Q2 (USD). Row for this filer:
{"accn":"0001193125-26-352329","cik":1628063,"entityName":"SERITAGE GROWTH PROPERTIES","loc":"US-NY","start":"2025-04-01","end":"2025-06-30","val":4653000}

claims.text: SRG’s stated value-creation objective is asset monetization, with sale value enhanced through leasing, densification, entitlements and agreement changes.

citation.quote: The Company’s primary objective is to create value for its shareholders through the monetization of the Company's assets through the Plan of Sale, which can be suspended by the Board of Trustees. We look to enhance sale value through leasing our built footprint, densification of our sites, achievement of entitlements and modification of agreements that govern our properties.

claims.text: The revenue decline is relevant to that plan because SRG derives substantially all of its revenue from rents received under existing leases.

citation.quote: We derive substantially all of our revenue from rents received from tenants under existing leases at each of our properties. This revenue generally includes fixed base rents and recoveries of expenses that we have incurred and that we pass through to the individual tenants, in each case as provided in the respective leases.
